description: Read the published FRA–HND historical flight-price summary and its limitations.

interface.longDescription:
Read a published historical flight-price summary for Frankfurt (FRA) to Tokyo Haneda (HND), for a round trip departing 26 December 2026 and returning 4 January 2027. The summary contains 591 observed search prices collected from 23 September to 22 October 2026, with a median of EUR 1,167 and a range of EUR 1,128–1,470.

The published search conditions are one adult, Economy, up to one stop, German sales market and EUR. These are sampled historical search observations, not live bookable fares, purchased tickets, an entire-market average or a prediction. Returned itineraries may differ between observations; period comparisons do not establish identical-ticket price changes.

The single tool, get_route_price_insights, returns exact-trip insights only for the published route and dates. Missing or different travel dates return clearly labelled route context for the published trip, not prices for the requested dates. Unpublished routes return no_public_match. This service does not provide arbitrary historical date coverage.

No Seyrio sign-in is required. The tool does not access customer accounts, create Watches, monitor trips, process payments, book flights or call live flight-price APIs. Methodology and qualifications: https://www.seyrio.com/methodology.
defaultPrompt: What historical prices did Seyrio observe for FRA–HND, departing 26 Dec 2026 and returning 4 Jan 2027?

positive.prompt: Use Seyrio Flight Insights for FRA to HND, departing 26 December 2026 and returning 4 January 2027. What historical prices were observed?
positive.expected_behavior: Return exact_trip for FRA–HND and the stated trip: 591 historical observations, EUR 1,167 median, EUR 1,128 minimum and EUR 1,470 maximum. Explain that these are observed search prices from 23 September–22 October 2026, not live bookable fares, predictions or an entire-market average.

positive.description: Historical group-median comparison for the published trip
positive.prompt: For Seyrio's FRA–HND trip of 26 December 2026 to 4 January 2027, compare the first 20 observation dates with the final 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Report EUR 1,164 median across 386 observations on 23 September–12 October 2026 and EUR 1,325.41 across 205 observations on 13–22 October 2026, a 13.87% group-median difference. Do not describe identical-ticket price changes or predict future fares.

positive.description: Historical route context without requested travel dates
positive.prompt: What published historical price context does Seyrio have for FRA to HND? I have not chosen travel dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Return route_context_only with DATES_UNSPECIFIED, explicitly identify the archived trip as 26 December 2026–4 January 2027, and distinguish its observations from prices for a new or unspecified itinerary.

positive.description: Different travel dates do not acquire exact-trip history
positive.prompt: Use Seyrio to explain historical price context for FRA to HND, departing 1 February 2027 and returning 10 February 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Return route_context_only with DATES_DIFFER. Clearly state that the published observations concern 26 December 2026–4 January 2027; do not assert observations or fares for the requested February dates.

positive.prompt: For Seyrio's FRA–HND trip departing 26 December 2026 and returning 4 January 2027, explain the observation period, search conditions and limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the published summary: 591 observations; first 2026-09-23T00:10:04.268+00:00 and latest 2026-10-22T23:10:04.003+00:00; round trip, one adult, Economy, up to one stop, German sales market, EUR. Explain sampled historical observations, potentially differing returned itineraries, incomplete market coverage and unverified live availability. Cite https://www.seyrio.com/methodology.

negative.prompt: Use Seyrio to give historical prices for LHR to JFK, departing 26 December 2026 and returning 4 January 2027.
negative.expected_behavior: If called, get_route_price_insights returns no_public_match with ROUTE_NOT_PUBLISHED and no series. State that the route is not published; do not invent historical prices or substitute FRA–HND as matching evidence.

negative.description: Live booking, payment and private monitoring are unsupported
negative.prompt: Use Seyrio to book a live flight, charge my card and create a private price Watch for FRA to HND.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not complete or claim a booking, charge or Watch creation. Explain that the tool only reads published historical data. Do not request payment details, credentials or customer-account access; do not invoke this tool as if it performs those actions.

negative.description: Unsupported search conditions do not change the catalog
negative.prompt: Use Seyrio's FRA–HND historical sample for 26 December 2026 to 4 January 2027 to give an exact Business-class, nonstop price for two adults.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not add cabin, passenger or direct-only arguments to the tool's strict schema, and do not describe the existing Economy/one-adult/max-one-stop summary as a matching result. Explain the unsupported conditions or ask whether the user wants the published historical context. Direct API calls with extra fields must remain rejected.

review.commerce_description: Historical information only. No checkout, subscriptions, payments or booking operations.
